_readme: Site-wide settings. Edit and commit; GitHub rebuilds the site (preview: python3 scripts/build.py). Never put placeholder prices or contacts here: leave a value empty and the site hides it.

claims._readme: Claims rule (brief Part 7). Set a claim to true ONLY when testing supports it (CTO sign-off). While false, the site says 'designed to' and shows a 'testing in progress' note.

evidence._source: VenGuard HCD Submission v4 (BFSCD figure as cited there)

contact._readme: Real values only. Leave empty until confirmed; empty values are not shown anywhere on the site.

endpoints._readme: leads: URL of the Google Apps Script web app (backend/apps-script/Code.gs) or any server that accepts the lead JSON. Empty = forms run in demo mode and keep a copy in the browser only.

tracking._readme: Leave an ID empty to switch that tool off. Nothing loads until the visitor accepts analytics cookies.

gallery._readme: Product showcase strip (homepage + Home kit page). type 'image': src = file name in assets/img without extension (needs .jpg and .webp). type 'video': short SILENT clip (5-10 s, H.264 MP4 under ~1.5 MB) in assets/video/ plus a poster image; it plays muted only while on screen and never on data-saver / slow connections / reduced-motion. Real kitchens, real hands, no stock footage.

connected._readme: Customer app (VENGuard/app/). firebase: paste the Firebase web config object from backend/connected/README.md step 3. Empty = the app runs as a demo with example data.
